countDefinition: Number of individual RNA-seq sample rows shown for this exact gene, study and source entry. Multiple samples do not establish that donors are independent; unique donor counts remain unknown unless there is only one sample. Per-entry counts remain separate. The UI may total distinct sample IDs across mapped entries within a study; this is a tissue-sample total, never an independent-donor total.
